content:
In the quiet of the night
When shadows dance in the moonlight
I sit and ponder the world's delight
And let my thoughts take flight

The stars above twinkle so bright
A symphony of celestial light
In the darkness, they shine so right
Guiding me through the endless night

I close my eyes and drift away
To a world where dreams will play
Where worries fade and fears decay
And love will always hold sway

So let me linger in this place
Where time and space just embrace
And in the silence, I find grace
A moment of peace, a sacred trace

For in the stillness of the night
I find solace, I find respite
And in the shadows, I see the light
A gentle reminder that all is right.
